newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling stable vs dlr in matched market.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling stable vs dlr in matched market.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling held steady against the dollar unchanged for the third straight day on Thursday in an evenly matched market, foreign exchange dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.85 unchanged against the dollar, while against the pound it was posted at a mean rate of 88.72 from 88.24.
"The shilling is very stable. There are good inflows coming in from foreign investors who are in the market to buy treasury bills," a dealer told Reuters.
Dealers said inflows from coffee and tea sales and central bank participation in the market partly accounted for the shilling's stability.
"The bank was in the market and bought all the excess dollars at 54.85," one dealer said.

The money market was slightly short due a net outflow of about two billion dollars from last week's treasury bill auction. Dealers said they expect the liquidity to tighten with excise and value added tax payments due Thursday.
Overnight rates were quoted at 14-16 percent compared to 10-15 on Wednesday.
